items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: one piece I'll never forget he played, Alexander's Ragtime Band. He could play that all day for me.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of that?
Louder. Yeah, one piece I'll never forget he played, Alexander's Ragtime Band. He could play that all day for me.
